extracted_concepts.name: Vector in Rⁿ
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An ordered n-tuple v = (v₁, v₂, ..., vₙ).

extracted_concepts.name: Ordered n-tuple
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The tuple form (v₁, v₂, ..., vₙ) representing a vector in Rⁿ.

extracted_concepts.name: Vector addition
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: u + v = (u₁+v₁, ..., uₙ+vₙ).

extracted_concepts.name: Scalar multiplication
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: cv = (cv₁, ..., cvₙ).

extracted_concepts.name: Linear combination
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: w is a linear combination of v₁,...,vₖ if w = c₁v₁ + ... + cₖvₖ.

extracted_concepts.name: Span
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The set of all linear combinations of {v₁, ..., vₖ}.

extracted_concepts.name: Spanning set
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A set of vectors whose span covers the whole space V.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear independence
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: c₁v₁ + ... + cₖvₖ = 0 implies c₁ = ... = cₖ = 0.

extracted_concepts.name: Basis
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A linearly independent spanning set for V.

extracted_concepts.name: Dimension
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: dim(V) is the number of vectors in any basis.

extracted_concepts.name: Basis invariance theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Any two bases for a finite-dimensional vector space have the same number of vectors.

extracted_concepts.name: Finite-dimensional vector space
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A vector space having a basis with finitely many vectors.

extracted_concepts.name: Change of basis
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Converting coordinates between two bases B and B'.

extracted_concepts.name: Transition matrix
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Matrix P satisfying [x]_B' = P⁻¹[x]_B.

extracted_concepts.name: Coordinate vector
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The representation [x]_B of a vector x relative to a basis B.

extracted_concepts.name: Rank
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: rank(A) = dimension of column space = dimension of row space.

extracted_concepts.name: Nullity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: nullity(A) = dimension of the null space.

extracted_concepts.name: Column space
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The space spanned by the columns of A; its dimension is rank(A).

extracted_concepts.name: Row space
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The space spanned by the rows of A; its dimension equals rank(A).

extracted_concepts.name: Null space
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The space of solutions to Ax = 0; its dimension is nullity(A).

extracted_concepts.name: Rank-Nullity Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: rank(A) + nullity(A) = n.

extracted_concepts.name: Vector space
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The abstract framework for understanding linear equations, matrices, and linear transformations.

extracted_concepts.name: Matrix
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A rectangular array A with column space, row space, null space, rank and nullity.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear transformation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A structure-preserving map between vector spaces, understood via the vector space framework.

extracted_concepts.name: System of linear equations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Linear equations understood through the abstract framework of vector spaces.
